opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
protocol_type: Host-mastered command-response over LPC / SPI / I2C MMIO FIFO; commands are octet streams that begin with a 10-byte header (TPM_ST + commandSize + commandCode) followed by handle area, authorization session area, and parameter area; responses mirror the framing.

values.name: TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS
values.description: Command has no authorization session area.

values.name: TPM_ST_SESSIONS
values.description: Command has one or more authorization sessions; authorizationSize precedes the session area.

fields.name: commandSize
fields.description: Total command size in bytes, including this header (network byte order).

fields.name: commandCode
fields.description: Command code; values defined in Part 2 Table 12 (range 0x0000011A..0x00000193+).

command_body_after_header: Handle area: 0..N TPM_HANDLEs (Part-3 per-command spec defines N).
Session area (only if tag == TPM_ST_SESSIONS): authorizationSize:UINT32 followed by 1..3 TPMS_AUTH_COMMAND structures.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Mirrors the command tag (TPM_ST_NO_SESSIONS or TPM_ST_SESSIONS).

fields.name: responseSize
fields.description: Total response size in bytes, including this header.

fields.name: responseCode
fields.description: TPM_RC_SUCCESS (0x00000000) or an error code from Part 2 Table 16.

response_body_after_header: Handle area (rare; only TPM2_StartAuthSession, TPM2_HMAC_Start, TPM2_Load, TPM2_LoadExternal, TPM2_CreatePrimary, TPM2_ContextLoad).
Parameter area: per-command marshalled response parameters.
Session area (only if tag == TPM_ST_SESSIONS): 1..3 TPMS_AUTH_RESPONSE structures.

channels.name: host_to_tpm_command_fifo
channels.description: Octet stream of the marshalled command, written to TPM_DATA_FIFO.

channels.name: tpm_to_host_response_fifo
channels.description: Octet stream of the marshalled response, read from TPM_DATA_FIFO.

channels.name: tpm_sts_interrupt
channels.description: Edge-triggered SERIRQ / GPIO indicating dataAvail / commandReady / interrupt cause.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: Host writes 1 to TPM_STS.commandReady to request bus ownership; TPM clears commandReady when ready to accept the command.
Host writes the command octet stream into TPM_DATA_FIFO (burst-friendly).
Host writes 1 to TPM_STS.tpmGo to signal command complete and start execution.
TPM sets TPM_STS.dataAvail when the response is ready; host reads the response from TPM_DATA_FIFO.
Host writes 1 to TPM_STS.responseRetry on a retry; writes 1 to TPM_STS.commandCancel during execution to abort.
burst_count_register: TPM_STS[15:8] = burstCount — number of bytes the TPM can accept (or supply) in a single burst without polling.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Startup
key_commands.description: Initialize TPM; argument TPM_SU_CLEAR (0x0000) for fresh boot or TPM_SU_STATE (0x0001) for resume.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Shutdown
key_commands.description: Orderly shutdown; argument TPM_SU_CLEAR / TPM_SU_STATE.

key_commands.name: TPM2_SelfTest
key_commands.description: Run TPM self-test (full or incremental).

key_commands.name: TPM2_IncrementalSelfTest
key_commands.description: Self-test only the algorithms in the supplied list.

key_commands.name: TPM2_GetTestResult
key_commands.description: Return manufacturer-defined test result vector and overall status.

key_commands.name: TPM2_GetRandom
key_commands.description: Get bytesRequested random octets from the TPM RNG.

key_commands.name: TPM2_StirRandom
key_commands.description: Mix host-supplied entropy into the TPM RNG state.

key_commands.name: TPM2_GetCapability
key_commands.description: Query algorithm/handle/PCR/property tables.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PCR_Read
key_commands.description: Read the current value of selected PCRs across selected banks.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PCR_Extend
key_commands.description: PCR_new = H_bank(PCR_old || measurement) for every selected PCR in every selected bank.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PCR_Event
key_commands.description: Hash eventData then extend the resulting digest into the selected PCRs.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PCR_Allocate
key_commands.description: Reconfigure PCR bank allocation; takes effect after reboot.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PCR_Reset
key_commands.description: Reset a single resettable PCR (typically PCR16, PCR23).

key_commands.name: TPM2_HashSequenceStart
key_commands.description: Start a multi-update hash sequence; returns sequenceHandle.

key_commands.name: TPM2_SequenceUpdate
key_commands.description: Feed octets into a running hash/HMAC sequence.

key_commands.name: TPM2_SequenceComplete
key_commands.description: Finalize hash sequence; return digest.

key_commands.name: TPM2_StartAuthSession
key_commands.description: Start HMAC / Policy / Trial session; returns sessionHandle (transient, 0x03xxxxxx).

key_commands.name: TPM2_PolicyPCR
key_commands.description: Bind a policy session to a current PCR digest snapshot.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PolicySigned
key_commands.description: Add a signed-authorization assertion to a policy session.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PolicyAuthorize
key_commands.description: Replace the current policy digest with a signature-protected new digest (policy update mechanism).

key_commands.name: TPM2_PolicyOR
key_commands.description: Set the policy digest to the hash of an OR of digests.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PolicyAuthValue
key_commands.description: Require authValue be supplied at command time.

key_commands.name: TPM2_PolicyPassword
key_commands.description: Require password authorization.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Create
key_commands.description: Create a new child object under parentHandle; returns (outPublic, outPrivate, creationData, creationHash, creationTicket).

key_commands.name: TPM2_CreatePrimary
key_commands.description: Create a primary object directly from a hierarchy seed; returns transient handle.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Load
key_commands.description: Load a previously created child (inPublic, inPrivate) under parentHandle; return transient handle.

key_commands.name: TPM2_LoadExternal
key_commands.description: Load an externally generated public area (and optional sensitive); used for verification keys.

key_commands.name: TPM2_FlushContext
key_commands.description: Remove transient object / session from TPM slot.

key_commands.name: TPM2_ContextSave
key_commands.description: Save the context of a transient object or session for off-TPM persistence (encrypted to PPS).

key_commands.name: TPM2_ContextLoad
key_commands.description: Restore a saved context to a slot.

key_commands.name: TPM2_EvictControl
key_commands.description: Move a transient handle to persistent (0x81xxxxxx) or remove a persistent object.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Sign
key_commands.description: Sign a 32-byte digest using a loaded signing key.

key_commands.name: TPM2_VerifySignature
key_commands.description: Verify a digest signature against a loaded public key.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Quote
key_commands.description: Sign a digest of selected PCRs + qualifyingData under a loaded restricted signing key.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Certify
key_commands.description: Sign a Name+qualifiedName of a loaded object.

key_commands.name: TPM2_GetSessionAuditDigest
key_commands.description: Sign the current session audit digest.

key_commands.name: TPM2_RSA_Encrypt
key_commands.description: RSA encrypt using padding scheme from key public area.

key_commands.name: TPM2_RSA_Decrypt
key_commands.description: RSA decrypt (or recover signature).

key_commands.name: TPM2_ECDH_KeyGen
key_commands.description: Generate ephemeral ECC keypair; return public point and shared Z.

key_commands.name: TPM2_ECDH_ZGen
key_commands.description: Compute Z from a stored key and externally supplied point.

key_commands.name: TPM2_HMAC
key_commands.description: One-shot HMAC.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Hash
key_commands.description: One-shot hash.

key_commands.name: TPM2_NV_DefineSpace
key_commands.description: Allocate an NV index.

key_commands.name: TPM2_NV_Read
key_commands.description: Read NV index data.

key_commands.name: TPM2_NV_Write
key_commands.description: Write NV index data.

key_commands.name: TPM2_NV_Increment
key_commands.description: Increment NV counter.

key_commands.name: TPM2_NV_Extend
key_commands.description: Extend NV extend-index (hash chain like a PCR).

key_commands.name: TPM2_NV_UndefineSpace
key_commands.description: Free an NV index.

key_commands.name: TPM2_Clear
key_commands.description: Wipe Storage hierarchy; reseed SPS; clear Owner authValue + lockoutAuth.

key_commands.name: TPM2_HierarchyControl
key_commands.description: Enable / disable a hierarchy.

key_commands.name: TPM2_HierarchyChangeAuth
key_commands.description: Change a hierarchy's authValue.

key_commands.name: TPM2_DictionaryAttackLockReset
key_commands.description: Reset the dictionary-attack failure counter.

key_commands.name: TPM2_FieldUpgradeStart
key_commands.description: Begin firmware field upgrade (vendor-controlled).
